name: Omnicell, Inc.
summary: Omnicell, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, provides healthcare technology in the United States and internationally. It offers hospital and health systems solutions, such as points of care for clinician workflows in patient care areas of the healthcare system; Titan XT, an automated dispensing system; XTExtend, a console swap for its XT cabinets; and Central Pharmacy Dispensing Service for the medication dispensing process.
